npc.guide_alexena.stdmod_10: [FR] The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I escort newcomers there.
npc.guide_alexena.stdmod_11: [FR] I'll help you find your way through Carlin, the amazon town. I can mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town and the world status.
npc.guide_alexena.stdmod_12: [FR] This city is ruled by Queen Eloise with the help of her female brigade. We have a lot of shops here as well as the usual facilities like depot, temple and so on.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_1: [FR] Hello, is this your first visit to Darashia? I can show you around a little.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_2: [FR] I'm well informed about the status of the world despite all the recent changes.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_3: [FR] Need some help finding your way through Darashia? Let me assist you.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_4: [FR] Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_5: [FR] Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops, spell trainers and the depot, as well as about the world status.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_6: [FR] The temple is a few floors over the depot. Just walk up the numerous stairs there.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_7: [FR] Muzir takes care of our bank business. His office is in the north-western part of the caliph's palace.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_8: [FR] You can buy weapons, armor, tools, gems, magical equipment, furniture, spells and food here.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_9: [FR] The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I escort newcomers there.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_10: [FR] I'll show you around Darashia if you like. I can mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town and the world status.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_11: [FR] Darashia is an oriental settlement ruled by Caliph Kazzan Ibn Gadral. We have a lot of shops, carpet travel and a rotworm plague, that sums it about up.
npc.guide_behil.stdmod_12: [FR] My name is Behil. Glad to be your guide.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_1: [FR] I'm informed about the status the world is in. If you have questions, let me know.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_2: [FR] Need some help finding your way through Liberty Bay? Let me assist you.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_3: [FR] Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_4: [FR] Hello, is this your first visit to Liberty Bay? I can show you around the town.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_5: [FR] Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops, spell trainers and the depot, as well as about the world status.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_6: [FR] The temple is just north west of the depot. You can't miss it.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_7: [FR] Jefrey, our bank clerk, can be found inside the depot. Easy to find.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_8: [FR] You can buy weapons, armor, tools, gems, magical equipment, furniture and food here.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_9: [FR] The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I escort newcomers there.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_10: [FR] Well, I'm a guide. I can mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town. I do this for free, but I'm always happy about a small donation if you can spare some money.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_11: [FR] This city has three main districts - a noble district, a merchant district and the slums. The class difference is clearly visible here. Most shops are in the merchant district. There are also large sugarcane plantations.
npc.guide_davina.stdmod_12: [FR] I'm Davina. Glad to help you today.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_1: [FR] Want to know the status of all the world changes? Ask me.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_2: [FR] Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops, spell trainers and the depot, as well as about the world status.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_3: [FR] The temple is just south west of here. Actually, it's a temple raft and the priestess is somewhat... meow... you'll see what I mean.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_4: [FR] Our bank clerk Znozel is somewhat... special. You can find him north of this harbour and then to the right, past the tavern.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_5: [FR] You can buy weapons, armor, tools, gems, magical equipment, furniture, spells and food here.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_6: [FR] The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I escort newcomers there, but it's just north of here.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_7: [FR] I'm the only feline guide in Tibia. I might not have fingers anymore, but with my paw I can still mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town and the world status.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_8: [FR] Yalahar is a very old city of gigantic size, consisting of a city centre and eight quarters. The beings that are closest to be called rulers of the city are the Yalahari.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_9: [FR] I'm Jonathan. Pleased to meet you.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_1: [FR] I can inform you about the status of this world, if you're interested.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_2: [FR] Hello, is this your first visit to Venore? I can show you around a little.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_3: [FR] Talk to me if you need directions.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_4: [FR] Need some help finding your way through Venore? Let me assist you.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_5: [FR] Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_6: [FR] Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops - well, warehouses - spell trainers and the depot, as well as about the adventurer's guild, hunting grounds, quests and the world status.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_7: [FR] The temple is pretty much in the middle of Venore. If you go south from this harbour, you can't miss it.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_8: [FR] The bank as well as jewel stores can be found in the House of Wealth, in the north-eastern part of Venore. I can mark it on your map if you want.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_9: [FR] You can buy almost everything here! Visit one of our warehouses for weapons, armors, magical equipment, spells, gems, tools, furniture and everything else you can imagine.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_10: [FR] The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I escort newcomers there.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_11: [FR] I will help you find your way in the buzzing city of Venore. I can mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town and the world status.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_12: [FR] This trading city has been built directly over a swamp and basically stands on stone pillars. We have many large warehouses here. To speak of 'shops' would be an understatement.
npc.guide_elena.stdmod_13: [FR] I'm Elena, sweetheart. I love your name, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_1: [FR] Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_2: [FR] Hello, is this your first visit to Thais? I can show you around a little.
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_3: [FR] Need some help finding your way through Thais? Let me assist you.
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_4: [FR] Talk to me if you need directions.
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_5: [FR] Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops, spell trainers and the depot, as well as about the world status.
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_6: [FR] The temple is near the shop area in the eastern part of the castle. Just go downstairs.
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_7: [FR] Our local bank clerk is called Ebenizer. You can find him north of the depot, near the food shop.
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_8: [FR] You can buy weapons, armor, tools, gems, magical equipment, furniture, spells and food here.
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_9: [FR] I'm your guide to the beautiful town Edron. I can mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town and the world status.
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_10: [FR] The town of Edron with its shops and facilities is built inside strong castle walls. Another remarkable building is the magic academy.
npc.guide_jonathan.stdmod_11: [FR] I'm Jonathan. Pleased to meet you.
npc.guide_kunibert.stdmod_1: [FR] Talk to me if you need directions.
npc.guide_kunibert.stdmod_2: [FR] Hello, is this your first visit to Rathleton? I can show you around a little.
npc.guide_kunibert.stdmod_3: [FR] Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
npc.guide_kunibert.stdmod_4: [FR] Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops, spell trainers and the depot, as well as about the world status.
npc.guide_kunibert.stdmod_5: [FR] The temple can be found in one of the uptown districts. Look for stairs up from the lower city, you'll find the temple in the northwest of the upper city.
npc.guide_kunibert.stdmod_6: [FR] The First Oramond Bank is an important part of Rathleton, and is situated in the centre of the upper city. I can mark it on your map if you want.
npc.guide_kunibert.stdmod_7: [FR] You can buy almost everything here! Visit one of our shops for weapons, armors, magical equipment, spells, gems, tools, furnitureand everything else you can imagine.
npc.guide_kunibert.stdmod_8: [FR] The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I escort newcomers there.
npc.guide_kunibert.stdmod_9: [FR]  I will help you find your way in the marvellous city of Rathleton. I can mark important locations on your map and give you someinformation about the town and the world status.
npc.guide_kunibert.stdmod_10: [FR] This city is a modern marvel of progress. The city's wealth and industry is based on the famous glooth. The magistrate runs the city according to the wishes of its inhabitants.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_1: [FR] Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_2: [FR] Hello, is this your first visit to Thais? I can show you around a little.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_3: [FR] Need some help finding your way through Thais? Let me assist you.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_4: [FR] Talk to me if you need directions.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_5: [FR] I can tell you all about the {town}, its {temple}, the {bank}, {shops}, {spell trainers} and the {depot}, as well as about the {world status}.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_6: [FR] The temple is in the centre of Thais. Walk east from the harbour and pass by the {depot} until you reach the infamous crossroads, then turn south.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_7: [FR] We have two bankers, Suzy and Naji. Naji is right in the depot. For Suzi, exit the {depot} to the west and walk south-west. Don't forget that I can {mark} important locations on your map.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_8: [FR] You can buy {weapons}, {armor}, {tools}, {gems}, {magical} equipment, {furniture} and {food} here.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_9: [FR] The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I {escort} newcomers there.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_10: [FR] I'm a guide, overworked and underpaid. I can mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town and the world status.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_11: [FR] Thais is the oldest settlement in Tibia. You can hear its history whisper when walking through the streets. Beware of criminals, but else it's a fine city.
npc.guide_luke.stdmod_12: [FR] I'm Luke. No jokes, please, I heard them all!
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_1: [FR] Need some help finding your way through Ankrahmun? Let me assist you.
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_2: [FR] Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_3: [FR] Need to know something about the status of this world? Let me answer your questions.
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_4: [FR] Hello, is this your first visit to Ankrahmun? I can show you around a little.
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_5: [FR] Talk to me if you need directions.
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_6: [FR] Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops, spell trainers and the depot.
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_7: [FR] The temple is in the south-eastern part of town. If you exit the depot to the south and walk east - slightly south-east - you can't miss it.
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_8: [FR] Tesha is in charge of both the bank and the gem store. You can find her on the market pyramid. Just exit the depot on the north side and walk up the next pyramid.
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_9: [FR] You can buy weapons, armor, tools, gems, magical equipment, furniture, spells and food here.
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_10: [FR] The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I escort newcomers there.
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_11: [FR] I will help you to find your way around Ankrahmun. I can mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town.
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_12: [FR] Ankrahmun consists almost completely of pyramids. You can walk up and down those pyramids just like you'd climb up stairs. Most shops are on the upper floors.
npc.guide_rahlkora.stdmod_13: [FR] My name is Rahlkora. I'm a guide.
npc.guide_thelandil.stdmod_1: [FR] Hello, is this your first visit to Ab'Dendriel? I can show you around a little.
npc.guide_thelandil.stdmod_2: [FR] Talk to me if you need directions.
npc.guide_thelandil.stdmod_3: [FR] Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
npc.guide_thelandil.stdmod_4: [FR] If you want to know something about the status of this world, talk to me.
npc.guide_thelandil.stdmod_5: [FR] Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops, spell trainers and the depot, as well as about the world status.
npc.guide_thelandil.stdmod_6: [FR] The temple is built around the elves' holy tree. You can find it north of this harbour.
npc.guide_thelandil.stdmod_7: [FR] Finarfin is in charge of the bank. You can find him on the lowest floor of the depot.
npc.guide_thelandil.stdmod_8: [FR] You can buy weapons, armor, tools, gems, magical equipment, instruments, furniture, spells and food here.
npc.guide_thelandil.stdmod_9: [FR] The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I escort newcomers there.
npc.guide_thelandil.stdmod_10: [FR] The elves have constructed Ab'Dendriel mainly in and on trees. There is also a large underground cave system with shops, a prison and troll caves.
npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_1: [FR] Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_2: [FR] Hello, is this your first visit to Port Hope? I can show you around a little.
npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_3: [FR] Talk to me if you need directions.
npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_4: [FR] Ask me if you want to know something about the world status!
npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_5: [FR] Need some help finding your way through Port Hope? Let me assist you.
npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_6: [FR] Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops, spell trainers and the depot, as well as about the world status.
npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_7: [FR] The temple is in the north-eastern part of town, left of the depot. The priest there has a little alcohol problem, though. It's sad.
npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_8: [FR] Our bank can be found one floor above the depot. Just talk to Ferks.
npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_9: [FR] The shops here are very close to one another. I can mark them for you if you'd like.
npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_10: [FR] The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I escort newcomers there.
npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_11: [FR] I'll help you not to get lost in Port Hope. I can mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town and the world status.
npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_12: [FR] The inhabitants of Port Hope are bravely facing the constant threat from the jungle. The town is built on pile dwellings and most shops are close to each other.
npc.guide_tiko.stdmod_13: [FR] I'm Tiko and your guide today. Have a good day!
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_1: [FR] Passages to Kazordoon! Gotta try the beer there.
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_2: [FR] Where do you want me to take you? To {Kazordoon}, {Farmine} or {Gnomprona}?
npc.habdel.stdmod_1: [FR] I sell the finest weapons in town. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_1: [FR] Me great {wizard}. Me great doctor of {ape people}. Me know many plants. Me old and me have seen many things.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_2: [FR] We see many things and learning quick. Merlkin magic learn quick, quick. We just watch and learn. Sometimes we try and learn.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_3: [FR] Things not good now. Need helper to do {mission} for me people.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_4: [FR] We be {kongra}, {sibang} and {merlkin}. Strange hairless ape people live in city called Port Hope.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_5: [FR] Kongra verry strong. Kongra verry angry verry fast. Take care when kongra comes. Better climb on highest tree.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_6: [FR] Sibang verry fast and funny. Sibang good gather food. Sibang know {jungle} well.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_7: [FR] Merlkin we are. Merlkin verry wise, merlkin learn many things quick. Teach other apes things a lot. Making {heal} and making {magic}.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_8: [FR] We see many things and learning quick. Merlkin magic learn quick, quick. We just watch and learn. Sometimes we try and learn.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_9: [FR] Jungle is dangerous. Jungle also provides us food. Take care when in jungle and safe you be.
npc.halvar.stdmod_1: [FR] What do you want to know? Something about the three different {difficulties}, the {general} rules or the {prices}? Maybe you also want to know what happens when you {die}?
npc.halvar.stdmod_2: [FR] There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_3: [FR] There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_4: [FR] There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_5: [FR] That is the easiest way in our arena. The {fee} is 1000 gold. We were setting this up for of our children to challenge some easy monsters and train them for the future.
npc.halvar.stdmod_6: [FR] The most common difficulty for us. The {fee} is 5000 gold. So if you are experienced in fighting middle class monsters this is your challenge!
npc.halvar.stdmod_7: [FR] Only the strongest among us will take this challenge. The {fee} is 10000 gold. If you pass that I promise you the respect of all citizens here. You will be a hero!
npc.halvar.stdmod_8: [FR] The fee is either 1000, 5000 or 10000 gold for one try. Remember that if you {die}, it is YOUR problem and you won't be able to get back to your corpse and your backpack.
npc.halvar.stdmod_9: [FR] It would be better not to die! In every pit there is an emergency exit, the portal to the south. If you die in a pit... well... your corpse and backpack are gone, so you enter the arena at your own risk.
npc.halvar.stdmod_10: [FR] Basically you pay me a {fee}, and you are sent into an arena with 10 different stages. If you succeed you will be rewarded accordingly.
npc.halvar.stdmod_11: [FR] My job is to explain about the rules and to get the fee from the competitors.
npc.halvar.stdmod_12: [FR] Well I would rather call it an {Ultimate Challenge} than a mission.
npc.hanna.stdmod_1: [FR] Gems and jewellery! Best prices in town!
npc.hanna.stdmod_2: [FR] I am a jeweler. Maybe you want to have a look at my wonderful offers.
npc.hardek.stdmod_1: [FR] Buying and selling all sorts of weapons and armors!
npc.hardek.stdmod_2: [FR] I am buying some weapons and armors.
npc.harlow.stdmod_1: [FR] So you are saying you're looking for someone to take you to Vengoth?
npc.harlow.stdmod_3: [FR] I could do that, it's not far from here. I don't run a charity organisation, though. Tell you what. Give me 100 gold pieces, and me and my boat are yours for the trip. Okay?
npc.harlow.stdmod_6: [FR] Want me to bring you to Vengoth again for 100 gold?
npc.harlow.stdmod_10: [FR] Well, I'm kind of a delivery man I guess. I take on small {transportation} jobs with my boat.
npc.harlow_vengoth.stdmod_1: [FR] Do you seek a passage to Yalahar for |TRAVELCOST|?
npc.harsky.stdmod_1: [FR] MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the king greet with his title!
npc.harsky.stdmod_2: [FR] MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the king greet with his title!
npc.hawkhurst_ingol.stdmod_2: [FR] Ye' want a passage back to cormaya? {Yes} or {no}.
npc.hawkhurst_ingol.stdmod_4: [FR] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.hawkhurst.stdmod_2: [FR] Ye' want a passage to the blasted isle, right? {Yes} or {no}?
npc.hawkhurst.stdmod_4: [FR] We would like to serve you some time.
npc.henricus.stdmod_1: [FR] It's a shame that only a few paladins still use their abilities to further the cause of the gods of good. Too many paladins have become selfish and greedy.
npc.henricus.stdmod_2: [FR] Nowadays, most knights seem to have forgotten the noble cause to which all knights were bound in the past. Only a few have remained pious, serve the gods and follow their teachings.
npc.henricus.stdmod_3: [FR] Those who wield great power have to resist great temptations. We have the burden to eliminate all those who give in to the temptations.
npc.henricus.stdmod_4: [FR] The druids here still follow the old rules. Sadly, the druids of Carlin have left the right path in the last years.
npc.henricus.stdmod_5: [FR] The dwarfs are allied with Thais but follow their own obscure religion. Although dwarfs keep mostly to themselves, we have to observe this alliance closely.
npc.henricus.stdmod_6: [FR] The dwarfs are allied with Thais but follow their own obscure religion. Although dwarfs keep mostly to themselves, we have to observe this alliance closely.
npc.henricus.stdmod_7: [FR] Those elves are hardly any more civilised than orcs. They can become a threat to mankind at any time.
npc.henricus.stdmod_8: [FR] Those elves are hardly any more civilised than orcs. They can become a threat to mankind at any time.
npc.henricus.stdmod_9: [FR] Venore is somewhat difficult to handle. The merchants have a close eye on our activities in their city and our authority is limited there. However, we will use all of our influence to prevent a second Carlin.
npc.henricus.stdmod_10: [FR] Drefia used to be a city of sin and heresy, just like Carlin nowadays. One day, the gods decided to destroy this town and to erase all evil there.
npc.henricus.stdmod_11: [FR] Darashia is a godless town full of mislead fools. One day, it will surely share the fate of its sister town Drefia.
npc.henricus.stdmod_12: [FR] Demons exist in many different shapes and levels of power. In general, they are servants of the dark gods and command great powers of destruction.
npc.henricus.stdmod_13: [FR] Carlin is a city of sin and heresy. After the reunion of Carlin with the kingdom, the inquisition will have much work to purify the city and its inhabitants.
npc.henricus.stdmod_14: [FR] We can see his evil influence almost everywhere. Keep your eyes open or the dark one will lead you on the wrong way and destroy you.
npc.henricus.stdmod_15: [FR] The church of Crunor works closely together with the druid guild. This makes a cooperation sometimes difficult.
npc.henricus.stdmod_16: [FR] We owe to the gods of good our creation and continuing existence. If it weren't for them, we would surely fall prey to the minions of the vile and dark gods.
npc.henricus.stdmod_17: [FR] The churches of the gods united to fight heresy and dark magic. They are the shield of the true believers, while the inquisition is the sword that fights all enemies of virtuousness.
npc.henricus.stdmod_18: [FR] The churches of the gods entrusted me with the enormous and responsible task to lead the inquisition. I leave the field work to inquisitors who I recruit from fitting people that cross my way.
npc.henricus.stdmod_19: [FR] Belive on the gods and they will show you the path.
npc.henricus.stdmod_20: [FR] By edict of the churches I'm the Lord Inquisitor.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_1: [FR] Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.humphrey.stdmod_2: [FR] So receive the embrace of Tibia, pilgrim.

npc.jack_springer.stdmod_3: [FR] I need your help in a matter of utmost {urgency}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_4: [FR] The situation is complicated and it's even hard to say where to {start} best, just to describe it to you.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_5: [FR] You see, several incidents in history can be traced back to a single {source}.

npc.jack_springer.stdmod_7: [FR] The recent rise of lycanthropy, the robbery of certain forbidden arcane texts and the vanishing of at least three dangerous individuals, targeted by the inquisition are just the tip of the {iceberg}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_8: [FR] This outside force is moving behind the scenes since ages. Our research suggests that this force probably even {predates} the rise of humanity.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_9: [FR] Well, we are sure that the puppeteer behind all these events is an organisation. So old that even its name, the Shiron'Fal, has lost its meaning, because the {language} it originates from is long dead.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_10: [FR] Here is where you come into play. We could identify the most recent plot of the Shiron'Fal and already had some {clashes}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_11: [FR] In our efforts to hinder their plot, we achieved mixed results at best. But now things are escalating fast and we have to {hurry}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_12: [FR] Our resources are already stretched thin, so we need your help with the most recent {problem}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_13: [FR] The legion tries to use a new form of twisted rituals to raise the bodies of well-known {knights}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_14: [FR] These powerful undead were a terrible threat on their own but it seems even they are just part of some larger {scheme} that we cannot make out yet.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_15: [FR] We are still working feverishly to uncover their goals but for now more imminent {threats} are at hand.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_16: [FR] Death cultists of the Shiron'Fal are trying to locate the bodies of fallen knights and raise them in blasphemous {rituals}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_17: [FR] The churches of the gods worked hand in hand to supply us with the means to {purge} the graves of those knights.

npc.jerom.stdmod_12: [FR] I'd go mad listening to this 'ribbit' the whole time. But each to his own!
npc.jerom.stdmod_13: [FR] I'm new here in Edron. I wanted to open up a pet shop. But now I'm ruined, uahahahaha <sniffs>.
npc.jerom.stdmod_14: [FR] I need to write a letter to the king. I'm not sure if those 2 million gold coins that Daniel Steelsoul demanded from me weren't too much.
npc.jerom.stdmod_15: [FR] I'm there from time to time, catching frogs. People like their bright colours.
npc.jerom.stdmod_16: [FR] My name is Jerom but no need to remember my name. All my belongings are destroyed and stolen. I'll be gone soon!
npc.jerom.stdmod_17: [FR] Raymond Striker offered me a contract to export parrots from Meriana but I won't need them anymore now that I'm ruined.
npc.jerom.stdmod_18: [FR] Not a very good spot to catch animals. At least no animals that pass off as pets.
npc.jerom.stdmod_19: [FR] Yesterday I would have said that I like all creatures of Tibia but TODAY my life has changed! When I catch this stinking troll!!
npc.jerom.stdmod_20: [FR] True, why not keep a rat as a pet! They can eat your trash, live inside your walls and you don't have to worry if one dies ! Could be a huge success....if I weren't ruined!!!!
npc.jerom.stdmod_21: [FR] That would be a mission for a hero.
npc.jerom.stdmod_22: [FR] Well, I don't see any other way than going back to my home country now.
npc.jerom.stdmod_23: [FR] Good idea! Easy to catch and once the owner has been bitten, he can't sue me anymore, hehehe!!.... but wait....I forgot....I'm ruined, uahahahaha <sniffs>.
npc.jerom.stdmod_24: [FR] I never make profit in Thais and most of the time I get robbed. I stopped visiting Thais for business some years ago.
npc.jerom.stdmod_25: [FR] I don't have anything to earn a living with, everything is destroyed! Otherwise I could offer you pets.
npc.jerom.stdmod_26: [FR] I saw a troll rummaging in the remains of my house last night! I'm sure this creature is behind that! But I am too weak to take revenge.
npc.jerom.stdmod_27: [FR] I've been to town and on my way back I heard a deafening sound. Then I saw that the sound came from a huge rock smashing my house.
npc.julius.stdmod_1: [FR] I come from a family of {vampire} hunters, but to be honest, I'm more into the theoretic part and strategic planning.
npc.julius.stdmod_2: [FR] A better name would be Gomorrah, if you ask me.
npc.julius.stdmod_4: [FR] Storkus? Oh yes, I know him. A long time ago we used to hunt together... sometimes.
npc.julius.stdmod_5: [FR] It's about time you showed the vampires that they should never bother the citizens again.
npc.julius.stdmod_6: [FR] Another vampire raid last night. But then again, that's nothing new.
npc.julius.stdmod_7: [FR] Well, I should be the one to thank you I guess.

npc.junkar_mines.stdmod_4: [FR] Well, then you stay here, simple as that.
npc.junkar_mines.stdmod_5: [FR] Where do you want me to take you? To {Kazordoon}, {Thais} or to {Robsons Isle}?

npc.junkar_robsons.stdmod_4: [FR] Well, then you stay here, simple as that.
npc.junkar_robsons.stdmod_5: [FR] Where do you want me to take you? To {Kazordoon} or to {Thais}? Occasionally we can even reach the {mines} if they are cleared.

npc.kais.stdmod_1: [FR] I have the power to grant you the blood of the mountain's blessing. But I must ask of you to sacrifice |BLESSCOST| gold. Are you prepared for that?
npc.kais.stdmod_2: [FR] So receive the blood of the mountain, master.
npc.kais.stdmod_3: [FR] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.kais.stdmod_4: [FR] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.kais.stdmod_5: [FR] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.kais.stdmod_6: [FR] I am Kais, Kais the Bound. Eternally {fixed} to the wretched place, unless... unless I prove my worth in aiding all those who seek my {help}.
npc.kais.stdmod_7: [FR] Well, as I am quite in a fix currently, my only hope to escape this situation may be to grant you {healing} or an {enhanced} blessing if you wish. You must desire SOMETHING, right? Sure you do.
npc.kais.stdmod_8: [FR] Besides the {enhanced} blessing available from me, I know of one other, granted by a solitary {nomad} far west of Svargrond. There are also five different other blessings available, each in a sacred place. ...\nThese blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.
npc.kais.stdmod_9: [FR] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.kais.stdmod_10: [FR] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.kais.stdmod_11: [FR] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.kais.stdmod_12: [FR] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.kais.stdmod_13: [FR] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.kais.stdmod_14: [FR] I know everyone and everything. It is certain that there is another enhanced blessing, the 'heart of the mountain'. Talk to a nomad far to the west of Svargrond, hiding slightly above ground.
npc.karith.stdmod_1: [FR] This weather is killing me. If I only had enough money to retire.
npc.karith.stdmod_2: [FR] I am the captain of this ship.
npc.karith.stdmod_3: [FR] I am the captain of this ship.
npc.karith.stdmod_4: [FR] I'm Karith. I don't belong to a caste any longer, and only serve the Yalahari.
npc.karith.stdmod_5: [FR] The city was a marvel to behold. It is certain that it have been the many foreigners that ruined it.
npc.karith.stdmod_6: [FR] Hello! Tell me what's on your mind. Time is money.

npc.kasmir.stdmod_2: [FR] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_4: [FR] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.kasmir.stdmod_7: [FR] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.kasmir.stdmod_9: [FR] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_11: [FR] I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, pilgrim.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_12: [FR] Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.kasmir.stdmod_13: [FR] So receive my prayer: 'Let there be honour and humility'. Now, bring your stake to Rahkem in Ankrahmun for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_15: [FR] You should visit Rahkem in Ankrahmun now, pilgrim.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_16: [FR] You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_17: [FR] A blessed stake? That is a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_18: [FR] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.

npc.kawill.stdmod_1: [FR] The Spark of the Phoenix is given by me and by the great pyromancer in the nearby fire temple. Do you wish to receive my part of the Spark of the Phoenix?
npc.kawill.stdmod_2: [FR] So receive the blessing of the life-giving earth, pilgrim.
npc.kawill.stdmod_3: [FR] Ok. If you don't want it...
npc.kawill.stdmod_4: [FR] The gods are treacherous and vain. They want to use us like they did in the past. Only the elements can be trusted, because all they want is for nature to run its set course.
npc.kawill.stdmod_5: [FR] I am the great geomancer of dwarvenkind.
npc.kawill.stdmod_6: [FR] We investigate the will of the earth. It is our duty to make sure things to work in their natural way.
npc.kawill.stdmod_7: [FR] Life is born by earth and fed by earth.
npc.kawill.stdmod_8: [FR] I am Kawill Marbleeye, Son of Earth, from the Molten Rock.
npc.kawill.stdmod_9: [FR] There's nothing I need, better ask others.
npc.kawill.stdmod_10: [FR] Nice world in general. It's a shame there is so much water ruining the general impression.
npc.kawill.stdmod_12: [FR] May the earth swallow them all!
npc.kawill.stdmod_13: [FR] Ah, a weapon to be feared by man, beast and god alike, jawoll. He who wields it will be both blessed and cursed at the same time.
npc.kawill.stdmod_14: [FR] The day will come when he finally bites the dust.
npc.kawill.stdmod_15: [FR] By using the powers of fire and earth we forced the river that once wound its way through the big old one in other directions, and created our home.
npc.kawill.stdmod_16: [FR] Bezil and Nezil have pawn and equpiment shop with an amazing stock.
npc.kawill.stdmod_17: [FR] Bezil and Nezil have pawn and equpiment shop with an amazing stock.
npc.kawill.stdmod_18: [FR] The first knight of dwarvenkind is a fine woman.
npc.kawill.stdmod_19: [FR] I fear the sorcerers focus on the destructive forces of fire. They forget about the protection earth could provide.
npc.kawill.stdmod_20: [FR] He is a jolly fellow and one of the oldest dwarves alive.
npc.kawill.stdmod_21: [FR] He is a fine smith and his armour may save your neck one day.
npc.kawill.stdmod_22: [FR] She is a fine cook, jawoll.
npc.kawill.stdmod_23: [FR] Uzgod is a blacksmith and understands the ways of his element well.
npc.kawill.stdmod_24: [FR] The emperor has rarely visited the temple district in the last years. He should care more about spirituality then about politics. Jawoll.
npc.kawill.stdmod_25: [FR] The emperor has rarely visited the temple district in the last years. He should care more about spirituality then about politics. Jawoll.
npc.kawill.stdmod_26: [FR] The celestial paladin, the protector of our race. The only divine being we care for and the only one who still cares for dwarfs.
npc.kawill.stdmod_27: [FR] Where earth is giving, fire is taking. That is the way of the elements.
npc.kawill.stdmod_28: [FR] The lifegiving earth protects us, feeds us and takes us home after death.
npc.kawill.stdmod_29: [FR] The mountain we live in is called the big old one. It's the mountain of mountains, and it isand like a friend and protector to our race.

npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_4: [FR] Well, the biggest problem we need to address are the ever charging {subterraneans} around here. And on top of that, there's the threat of the Lost, who quite made themselves at {home} in these parts.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_5: [FR] Maintainin' this whole operation, the dwarven involvement 'course. Don't know about them gnomes but if I ain't gettin' those dwarves in line, there'll be chaos down here. I also oversee the {defences} and {counterattacks}.
npc.kulag_the_guard.stdmod_1: [FR] It's my duty to protect the city.
npc.lailene.stdmod_1: [FR] ... what?! Uh - no, no. Of course I wouldn't have anything to do with... them.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_1: [FR] Here's the situation: a tide of hazardous bugs, the gnomes named them {diremaws}, threatens our base. Then there is some kind of {growth} which seems connected to them somehow. We need to get rid of both.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_2: [FR] Bashsmite. That's all you need to know.
npc.lea.stdmod_1: [FR] I am the archsorcerer of Carlin. I keep the secrets of our order.
npc.lea.stdmod_3: [FR] Sorry, I only sell spells to sorcerers.
npc.lea.stdmod_4: [FR] Time is a force we sorcerers will master one day.
npc.lea.stdmod_5: [FR] Any sorcerer dedicates his whole life to the study of the arcane arts.
npc.lea.stdmod_6: [FR] We sorcerers wield arcane powers beyond comprehension of men.
npc.lea.stdmod_7: [FR] We sorcerers wield arcane powers beyond comprehension of men.
npc.lector.stdmod_1: [FR] I can offer you ham or meat. If you'd like to check the quality of my wares, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_1: [FR] Ask me if you need help!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_2: [FR] Buy and sell everything you want here!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_3: [FR] No need to run from shop to shop, my place is all that's needed!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_6: [FR] I'm a merchant. If you like to see my offers, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_8: [FR] Well, it's a good idea to leave most of your money in the bank and only take what you need. That way your gold is safe.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_9: [FR] Oh no! I've got to watch what I eat. {Lily} loves cookies, though.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_10: [FR] There are many merchants in this village. Just ask them for a {trade} to see their offers. But I can promise you - my offers are the best around!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_11: [FR] I'm fine. I'm delighted to welcome you as my customer.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_12: [FR] What kind of information do you need? I could tell you about different topics such as {equipment}, {monsters} or {Rookgaard} in general.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_13: [FR] How can I help you? Would you like to {trade} with me? I can also give you general {hints}. Or just ask me anything you'd like to know.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_14: [FR] You should really take some time and travel around the marvellous areas of Tibia. There's everything - ice islands, deserts, jungles and mountains!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_15: [FR] The temple is the place to go when you are very low on {health} or poisoned. Ask {Cipfried} for a heal - he usually notices emergencies by himself.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_16: [FR] Health potions will heal you for about 75 hit points. It can't hurt to carry one with you, just in case.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_17: [FR] Well, very important equipment would be a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}. Maybe also a torch if you're heading into a dark {dungeon}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_18: [FR] I sell fishing rods and worms in case you want to go fishing. Simply ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_19: [FR] You could check out which weapons I offer by asking me for a {trade}. Don't be shy!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_20: [FR] Oh, I'm sorry, that's one of the things I don't have for sale. But {Willie} or {Billy} surely have something to eat for you.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_21: [FR] The king supports our little village very much!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_22: [FR] In the academy you can get a lot of information from books. You can also try out a few things by yourself.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_23: [FR] Isn't it lovely here? You'll be surprised once you reach the {mainland} -  so much to explore!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_24: [FR] Well, the mainland also consists of several continents. You can go there once you've reached level 8 and talked to the {oracle}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_25: [FR] Good monsters to start with are rats. They live in the {sewers} under the village of {Rookgaard}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_26: [FR] Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_27: [FR] Be careful down there! Make sure you bought enough {torches} and a {rope} or you might get lost.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_28: [FR] There are many sewer entrances throughout Rookgaard. If you want to know more details about monsters and dungeons, best talk to one of the guards.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_29: [FR] Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers. Apart from that, I also sell {footballs}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_30: [FR] I really love flowers. My favourites are {honey flowers}. Sadly, they are very rare on this isle. If you can find one for me, I'll give you a little reward.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_31: [FR] You could check out which armors or shields I offer by asking me for a {trade}. Don't be shy!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_32: [FR] Yes, I'm selling that. Simply ask me for a {trade} to view all my offers.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_33: [FR] Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_34: [FR] He sells {weapons}. However, I can offer you better deals than him!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_35: [FR] I'm glad she stopped selling stuff. There was too much of a competition going on!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_36: [FR] Sometimes, I see him walking outside the village near some hole.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_37: [FR] He dedicated his life to welcome newcomers to this island.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_38: [FR] Poor old woman, her son {Tom} never visits her.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_39: [FR] Al Dee has a general {equipment} store in the north-western part of the village.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_40: [FR] She lives under the {academy}. Always nice to chat with her!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_41: [FR] He's a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain health, it's a good place to go. He's only trading with premium adventurers, though.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_42: [FR] He's a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. However, many monsters carry also food such as meat. Or you could simply pick {blueberries}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_43: [FR] Visiting Cipfried in the {temple} is a good idea if you are injured or poisoned. He can heal you.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_44: [FR] She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}, just as I do.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_45: [FR] He mostly stays by himself. He's a hermit outside of town - good luck finding him.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_46: [FR] She buys all {blueberries} and {cookies} you can find.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_47: [FR] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to reach more areas of {Tibia}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_48: [FR] He is the {bank} clerk, just below the academy.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_49: [FR] Seymour is a teacher running the {academy}. He has a lot of important {information} about Tibia.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_50: [FR] He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_51: [FR] He is a great warrior and our protector.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_52: [FR] Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_55: [FR] Oh, but it's fun to play!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_56: [FR] Oh, thank you so much! Please take this piece of armor as reward.
npc.legola.stdmod_1: [FR] Teaching paladin spells! Just come to me!
npc.legola.stdmod_2: [FR] We are always looking for sniper gloves. They are supposed to raise accuracy. If you find a pair, bring them here. Maybe I can offer you a nice trade.
npc.lily.stdmod_1: [FR] Are you injured or poisoned? Get your potions here! All natural, no artificial ingredients!
npc.lily.stdmod_2: [FR] Hey you, over there! Let's have a little chat, shall we?
npc.lily.stdmod_3: [FR] Oh, just in case you are looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east.
npc.lily.stdmod_4: [FR] Anyone got some cookies for me?
npc.lily.stdmod_5: [FR] Do you need help? Just ask me about anything you'd like to know!
npc.lily.stdmod_6: [FR] I'm buying all of your blueberries for my famous blueberry juice!
npc.lily.stdmod_7: [FR] Oh. In that case, maybe you're interested in a {trade} - I sell potions and buy a few other things.
npc.lily.stdmod_8: [FR] Oh. Well, if you change your mind, let me know.
npc.lily.stdmod_9: [FR] No, you haven't. If you're looking for the way to Hyacinth, just leave the village to the north and then go east. I've marked it on your map!
npc.lily.stdmod_10: [FR] Is something... wrong? You didn't lose the herbs, did you?
npc.lily.stdmod_11: [FR] Well, at least you're honest. I can give you another sack, but only if you promise not to lose them this time. Okay?
npc.lily.stdmod_12: [FR] Phew. That's a relief. Well, don't forget to deliver them to Hyacinth! They have to be fresh to create potions.
npc.lily.stdmod_13: [FR] Oh. Well, if you change your mind, let me know.
npc.lily.stdmod_14: [FR] Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you. If you want to sell {blueberries}, ask me about them separately.
npc.lily.stdmod_15: [FR] Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers. If you want to sell {blueberries}, ask me about them separately.
npc.lily.stdmod_16: [FR] How can I help you? If you like to buy something, just ask me for a {trade}. We can also chat about {Tibia}. Or, I could give you general {hints} about the game.
npc.lily.stdmod_17: [FR] You definitely need a good {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}. Also, you should never leave for a {dungeon} without {rope}, {shovel} and {torch}.
npc.lily.stdmod_18: [FR] I'm in tune with myself and with nature. Thank you.
npc.lily.stdmod_19: [FR] I'm a {druid}, bound to the spirit of nature. My {potions} will help you if you feel bad. I also buy {blueberries} and {cookies}. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lily.stdmod_20: [FR] My name is Lily, like the flower. It also stands for purity, just like my {potions} are!
npc.lily.stdmod_21: [FR] It's about |TIME|. But does it really matter? Don't rush yourself and enjoy all these little moments.
npc.lily.stdmod_22: [FR] It's wise to store most of your gold at the bank below the academy. It's safer that way.
npc.lily.stdmod_23: [FR] If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
npc.lily.stdmod_24: [FR] Antidote potions will cure {poisoning}. They also have a lovely {blueberry} taste. You only need them when you get poisoned deep down in a dungeon, else just go to the {temple} for a free heal!
npc.lily.stdmod_25: [FR] Some creatures like snakes or poison spiders can poison you. That will diminish your health over a certain amount of time, so be careful when dealing with those creatures!
npc.lily.stdmod_26: [FR] Being a druid is a wonderful profession. You control the forces of nature and can heal others.
npc.lily.stdmod_27: [FR] There are many shops around here which are owned by local {citizens}.
npc.lily.stdmod_28: [FR] The temple is just to the right. You can get a healing for free there if you are badly injured or poisoned.
npc.lily.stdmod_29: [FR] Tibia is our beautiful world, created by the gods. Being a {druid}, I'm a worshipper of {Crunor}.
npc.lily.stdmod_30: [FR] Crunor is the great lord of trees and the creator of all plants. Despite what some people believe, he didn't create the {monsters}, though.
npc.lily.stdmod_31: [FR] Oh, I'm sorry honey, I don't sell food. If you are hungry, visit one of the farmers {Billy} and {Willie}. I buy {blueberries} and {cookies}, though.
npc.lily.stdmod_32: [FR] I can offer you homemade {antidote} potions and small {health} potions. Ask me for a {trade} if you like to see them.
npc.lily.stdmod_33: [FR] Health potions will heal you for about 75 hit points. It can't hurt to carry one with you, just in case.
npc.lily.stdmod_34: [FR] I think Tibia would be a better place without authorities who lead others to war. Can't we just all live in peace?
npc.lily.stdmod_35: [FR] The academy is the big stone building in the town centre. If you're ready to leave Rookgaard, go there to see the {oracle}.
npc.lily.stdmod_36: [FR] Well, in this village and its surroundings you can {train} your skills until you are level 8. Then you should see the {oracle} and head to the {main} continent.
npc.lily.stdmod_37: [FR] To train your skills, simply help us {fighting} monsters.
npc.lily.stdmod_38: [FR]  If you want to fight monsters, you should get better {equipment} from the {merchants}. You should also talk to one of the bridge {guards} to find suitable monsters for you.
npc.lily.stdmod_39: [FR] To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.lily.stdmod_40: [FR] The main continent is huge! The gods of Tibia created everything from great seas, deep jungles and large deserts.
npc.lily.stdmod_41: [FR] Sadly, our little village of {Rookgaard} is invaded by monsters. From the {dungeons} they creep to the surface and attack the city. We always need adventurers helping us to {fight} them.
npc.lily.stdmod_42: [FR] If you are looking for weapons, you should visit {Obi}'s shop east of here. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_43: [FR] Armors? Best buy them at {Dixi}'s little counter, just upstairs from {Obi}'s shop. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_44: [FR] Shields? Best buy them at {Dixi}'s little counter, just upstairs from {Obi}'s shop. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_45: [FR] If you need information about the dungeons here, you should talk to one of the bridge {guards}. They will show you where to go.
npc.lily.stdmod_46: [FR] Our bridge guards are {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus}. You can find Dallheim if you follow the path to the right, then turn north at the {temple}.
npc.lily.stdmod_47: [FR] Yum, cookies! If you have some for me, just ask me for a trade.
npc.lily.stdmod_48: [FR] Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up what they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.lily.stdmod_49: [FR] I will pay you 5 gold for every empty vial and potion flask. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lily.stdmod_50: [FR] You best buy such equipment at {Al Dee}'s store in the North of the village. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_51: [FR] Oh yes, I love cookies! Will you accept 1 gold for it?
npc.lily.stdmod_53: [FR] Sorry, you do not have one.
npc.lily.stdmod_55: [FR] Oh, do you have blueberries for sale? I need them for my {antidote potion}. I give you 1 gold for 5 of them, yes?
npc.lily.stdmod_57: [FR] Oh, I'm sorry. I'm not buying less than 5 blueberries.
npc.lily.stdmod_59: [FR] He sells {weapons}. His shop is east of here.
npc.lily.stdmod_60: [FR] I don't know what to think about all this new bar. {Rookgaard} needs a little peace!
npc.lily.stdmod_61: [FR] He used to help me gather blueberries. Then, one day, he suddenly stopped comming here. They say he went a little out of his mind.
npc.lily.stdmod_62: [FR] We tried everything to fight that cockroach plague in his cellar, but natural anti-bug potions simply won't help. I guess those roaches need to be fought with stronger weapons.
npc.lily.stdmod_63: [FR] That poor old woman. I wish I could help her.
npc.lily.stdmod_64: [FR] Best tool shop in town, if you ask me.
npc.lily.stdmod_65: [FR] I heard that she's recovering below the academy. She has been on an exciting expedition. I haven't talked to her yet, though.
npc.lily.stdmod_66: [FR] Visiting Cipfried in the {temple} is a good idea if you are injured or poisoned. He can heal you.
npc.lily.stdmod_67: [FR] She's {Obi}'s granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}, just upstairs from Obi's shop.
npc.lily.stdmod_68: [FR] Hyacinth also sells small health potions. He lives outside the village, in a hidden place.
npc.lily.stdmod_69: [FR] If you are a {premium} adventurer, you should check out {Lee'Delle's} shop. She lives in the western part of town, just across the bridge.
npc.lily.stdmod_71: [FR] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to reach more areas of {Tibia}.
npc.lily.stdmod_72: [FR] He takes care of the {bank}, keeping our money safe.
npc.lily.stdmod_73: [FR] Seymour is a teacher running the {academy}. He has many important {information} about Tibia.
npc.lily.stdmod_74: [FR] He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
npc.lily.stdmod_75: [FR] He is a great warrior. He can also tell you much about {monsters} and {dungeons} on this island.
npc.lily.stdmod_76: [FR] He's a farmer and sells {food}. Food will help you regain health when you are injured. Many {monsters} also carry food with them.
npc.lorek.stdmod_1: [FR] Do you seek a passage to
npc.lorek.stdmod_3: [FR] I heard he is some scary magician or so.
npc.lorek.stdmod_4: [FR] I can travel you to west, centre, darama, chor or banuta.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_1: [FR] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_2: [FR] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_4: [FR] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.lorietta.stdmod_7: [FR] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.lorietta.stdmod_9: [FR] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_11: [FR] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_12: [FR] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_13: [FR] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_14: [FR] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_15: [FR] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_16: [FR] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_17: [FR] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_18: [FR] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_19: [FR] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_20: [FR] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_21: [FR] The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_22: [FR] You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_23: [FR] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_24: [FR] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.lothar.stdmod_1: [FR] I enjoy the peace and solitude out here. You're welcome to be my guest as long as you behave in a quiet and tolerable manner.
npc.lothar.stdmod_2: [FR] Some call me {animal} whisperer. Others say I'm just crazy. I refer to myself as a simple {stable} keeper.
npc.lothar.stdmod_3: [FR] Some call me {animal} whisperer. Others say I'm just crazy. I refer to myself as a simple {stable} keeper.
npc.lothar.stdmod_4: [FR] I love all animals, whether small or big. I also believe each one, even the wildest and most ferocious being, can be talked to, understood and {tamed}.
npc.lothar.stdmod_5: [FR] It's my dream to shelter many different tamed animals. Maybe one day that dream will come true.
npc.lothar.stdmod_6: [FR] Well, usually you can tame animals with the help of a few simple items. If you've found such an {item}, show it to me and I might be able to help you with instructions on the taming process.
npc.lothar.stdmod_7: [FR] Well? Which item have you found and require advice for?
npc.lothar.stdmod_8: [FR] That's among the favourite foods of donkeys, as far as I know. It's a shame I haven't really seen any donkey around. It could require a magic trick to actually get to meet one.
npc.lothar.stdmod_9: [FR] Pandas love to eat bamboo leaves, but the Tiquandan pandas are actually not that skilled at climbing, so they have a hard time getting some for themselves. You might be able to tame one with them.
npc.lothar.stdmod_10: [FR] I heard that terror birds really love carrots. I'd try waving it in front of one of those.
npc.lothar.stdmod_11: [FR] Ah, what a pretty ribbon. Reminds me of the elusive dragonlings - they're quite elegant and vain. They would probably welcome a decorative element. They're sometimes spotted during volcano eruptions.
npc.lothar.stdmod_12: [FR] What a neat little elvish gadget. Did you know a diapason works with vibrations to create sound? I actually think this could work on a creature made of crystals.
npc.lothar.stdmod_13: [FR] I'm against violence towards any creature. I've heard those barbarians in the desert use it for disobedient dromedaries.
npc.lothar.stdmod_14: [FR] Oh, what a nice little plant! Did you know it's supposed to bring luck? So is the lady bug. Both of them might actually go well together.
npc.lothar.stdmod_15: [FR] I've heard that there once was a gang of manta ray riders who liked to adorn their mantas with a foxtail. Don't ask me why, maybe they like how it floats in the wind when running really fast?
npc.lothar.stdmod_16: [FR] What a strange device! This looks like a tool for someone who creates golems and modifies living creatures. You could probably tame a modded creature with it, but I doubt they live in the wild.
npc.lothar.stdmod_17: [FR] Oh, that's one of the favourite foods of a crustacea gigantica. I think you can just distract it with the food and quickly jump on its back.
npc.lothar.stdmod_18: [FR] Have you ever encountered a magma crawler? They only eat and drink really hot things. You could probably try and make one drink some glow wine - and quickly mount it as long as it's drunk.
npc.lothar.stdmod_19: [FR] Hm. What an interesting find. This is definitely not used for any sort of animal. Maybe a vehicle? I can imagine it could be used for a bike of some sorts.
npc.lothar.stdmod_20: [FR] That looks like it might fit a draptor. If you can ever get close enough to one to catch it, I'd simply try putting it on while whispering calming words.
npc.lothar.stdmod_21: [FR] The sound of a hunting horn is often intimidating to forest creatures, but I heard that wild boars actually like it.
npc.lothar.stdmod_22: [FR] Ironblights consist mainly of stone and iron. With a strong magnet like that you can basically force it to walk in the direction you're wanting it to.
npc.lothar.stdmod_23: [FR] Try catching a midnight panther using that one. Don't hit the panther, mind you. Just let the whip crack in the air - I think that will work.
npc.lothar.stdmod_24: [FR] As far as I know, leeches can be found in terrestrial, swampy areas. Leeches often help large animals such as water buffaloes to get rid of parasites.
npc.lothar.stdmod_25: [FR] You should show that giant jaw to a creature looking like the one you got it from. It will respect you when it sees those scary teeth.
npc.lothar.stdmod_26: [FR] Where did you get that? What a rare treat. This must have been crafted by someone who truly loves both music and animals. I can't tell you anything else about it.
npc.lothar.stdmod_27: [FR] Oh, a nail case..., I hate paring nails. But I heard gravediggers become trusting when they get the right treatment.
npc.lothar.stdmod_28: [FR] How impressive, a nightmare horn. Have you ever encountered a shock head? Try hypnotizing them with your horn.
npc.lothar.stdmod_29: [FR] You could probably ride a black sheep with these. Talk to it gently and carefully put on the reins.
npc.lothar.stdmod_30: [FR] Wow, that's a rarity. Have you ever met one of those large sandstone scorpions? They're quite impressive. You need such a sceptre to show to one that you're its new master.
npc.lothar.stdmod_31: [FR] That might be the only way to tame a bear. It has a sensitive spot right between the ears which will calm it down, but you're not strong enough for simple acupressure. Using the slingshot is likely to help you with that.
npc.lothar.stdmod_32: [FR] As the name indicates - this can be used to make a slug much faster than it normally is! Once you've tamed it, it will race you wherever you want to go.
npc.lothar.stdmod_33: [FR] Create sugar oat by just mixing a bunch of sugar cane with a bunch of wheat. All horses love sugar oat! Sometimes when the horses from the horse station in Thais are on the loose, wild horses mix with the herd. Maybe they can be tamed?
npc.lothar.stdmod_34: [FR] The interesting part about that bait isn't the sweet stuff - it's the flies attracted to the sweet smell. Spiders love to eat flies, especially the Zaoan ones.
npc.lothar.stdmod_35: [FR] Hm! Now that's an interesting one. Where did you get that from? I could imagine it winds something up in a factory, but it's definitely not a normal animal.
npc.loui.stdmod_3: [FR] What are you doing here?? Get away from that hole!
npc.loui.stdmod_5: [FR] I'm a {monk}. I wanted to do something here, but I forgot what it was when I fell in that {hole}.
npc.loui.stdmod_6: [FR] I'm a humble servant of the {gods}.
npc.loui.stdmod_7: [FR] They created Tibia and all lifeforms.
npc.loui.stdmod_8: [FR] I have no idea how long I've been in this {hole}. It seemed like an eternity!
npc.loui.stdmod_9: [FR] While looking for something - which I forgot - I found that {hole}. I went down, even though I had no torch. And then I heard {THEM}! There must be dozens!
npc.loui.stdmod_10: [FR] They were so many, EVERYWHERE! I could barely escape alive. I have no clue what THEY were but one more second down there and I'd have been dead!
npc.loui.stdmod_11: [FR] Sorry, I'm out of mana and ingredients, please visit Cipfried in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_12: [FR] The good thing is that those horrible rats stay mostly in town. The bad thing is that they do so because of bigger {monsters} that would devour them outside.
npc.loui.stdmod_13: [FR] Everything around us, that is Tibia.
npc.loui.stdmod_14: [FR] Most adventurers take their first steps there.
npc.loui.stdmod_15: [FR] Pah, king! He should do something about this {hole}!
npc.loui.stdmod_16: [FR] This is the place where everything starts.
npc.loui.stdmod_17: [FR] Was it...? Yes, I might have looked for blueberries as I foolishly entered this unholy {hole}.
npc.loui.stdmod_18: [FR] There must be an army of them, just down this {hole}.
npc.loui.stdmod_19: [FR] Then, they must be magic wielding beasts using creature illusion! Good thing you escaped.
npc.loui.stdmod_20: [FR] The gods blessed Tibia with abundant forms of life.
npc.loui.stdmod_21: [FR] The good thing is that those horrible rats stay mostly in town. The bad thing is that they do so because of bigger {monsters} that would devour them outside.
npc.loui.stdmod_22: [FR] I have no quests but to stay away from that {hole} and I recommend you to do the same.
npc.loui.stdmod_23: [FR] I'm penniless and poor as becomes a humble monk like me.
npc.loui.stdmod_24: [FR] She owns a shop in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_25: [FR] She owns a bar in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_26: [FR] Waaaah! Don't shock me like that!
npc.loui.stdmod_27: [FR] He has his own monsters, I believe.
npc.loui.stdmod_29: [FR] He owns a shop in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_30: [FR] Who's that? Never heard about her.
npc.loui.stdmod_31: [FR] He owns a shop in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_33: [FR] The gods may protect me from his rudeness.
npc.loui.stdmod_34: [FR] A hermit on the other side of town.
npc.loui.stdmod_35: [FR] The oracle! Yes! You should get off this island as fast as you can!
npc.loui.stdmod_37: [FR] Seymour is the headmaster of the local {academy}.
npc.loui.stdmod_38: [FR] I'm sure he has never seen monsters like those in this hole before.
npc.loui.stdmod_39: [FR] I tried to warn him about these monsters but he just laughed at me!! It's an outrage!
npc.lubo.stdmod_1: [FR] Stop by and rest a while, tired adventurer! Have a look at my wares!
npc.lubo.stdmod_2: [FR] I am selling equipment for adventurers. If you need anything, let me know.
npc.lubo.stdmod_3: [FR] This is Ruffy my dog, please don't do him any harm.
npc.lubo.stdmod_4: [FR] I sell torches, fishing rods, worms, ropes, water hoses, backpacks, apples, and maps.
npc.lubo.stdmod_5: [FR] I am Lubo, the owner of this shop.
npc.lubo.stdmod_6: [FR] Oh! I'm sorry, I sold the last one just five minutes ago.
npc.lubo.stdmod_7: [FR] My hat? Hanna made this one for me.
npc.lubo.stdmod_8: [FR] Oh, you sure mean this old story about the mage Dago, who lost two fingers when he conjured a dragon.
npc.lubo.stdmod_9: [FR] There are some strange stories about a magicians pet names. Ask Hoggle about it.
npc.luna.stdmod_1: [FR] Selling herbs, mushrooms and flowers, all picked under the light of the full moon!
npc.luna.stdmod_2: [FR] I'm selling various herbs, mushrooms, and flowers. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.

npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_28: [FR] Don't worry about time in the presence of your Queen.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_29: [FR] We need the assistance of heroes now and then. Even males prove useful now and then.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_30: [FR] The taxes in Carlin are not high, more a symbol than a sacrifice.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_31: [FR] I am the Queen, the only rightful ruler on the continent!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_32: [FR] Ask one of the soldiers about that.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_33: [FR] Our enemies are numerous. We have to fight vile monsters and have to watch this silly king in the south carefully.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_34: [FR] They dare to reject my reign over them!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_35: [FR] Isn't our city marvellous? Have you noticed the lovely gardens on the roofs?
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_36: [FR] My subjects maintain many fine shops. Go and have a look at their wares.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_38: [FR] The four major guilds are the Knights, the Paladins, the Druids, and the Sorcerers.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_39: [FR] They haven't troubled our city lately. I guess, they fear the wrath of our druids.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_41: [FR] It's a shame that the High Paladin does not reside in Carlin.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_42: [FR] The knights of Carlin are the bravest.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_43: [FR] The sorcerers have a small isle for their guild. So if they blow something up it does not burn the whole city to ruins.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_44: [FR] The druids of Carlin are our protectors and advisors. Their powers provide us with wealth and food.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_45: [FR] Carlin is a center of the forces of good, of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_46: [FR] The forces of evil have a firm grip on this puny city to the south.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_47: [FR] The order, Crunor gives the world, is essential for survival.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_48: [FR] Chaos is common in the southern regions, where they allow a man to reign over a realm.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_49: [FR] A mans tale ... that means 'nonsense', of course.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_50: [FR] If you want a reward, go and bring me something this silly King Tibianus wants dearly!
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_51: [FR] A dusgusting organisation, which could be only created by men.
npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_52: [FR] It is said that he lives on a small island near Edron. Maybe the people there know more about him.
npc.quentin.stdmod_1: [FR] Alright, I guess you need a stake first. Maybe Gamon can help you, the leg of a chair or something could just do. Try asking him for a stake, and if you have one, bring it back to me.
npc.quentin.stdmod_2: [FR] I guess you couldn't convince Gamon to give you a stake, eh?
npc.quentin.stdmod_3: [FR] Ah, I see you brought a stake with you. Are you ready to receive my line of the prayer then?
npc.quentin.stdmod_4: [FR] So receive my prayer: 'Light shall be near - and darkness afar'. Now, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.quentin.stdmod_6: [FR] You should visit Tibra in the Carlin church now.
npc.quentin.stdmod_7: [FR] You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.quentin.stdmod_8: [FR] So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.quentin.stdmod_9: [FR] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.quentin.stdmod_11: [FR] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.quentin.stdmod_14: [FR] Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.quentin.stdmod_16: [FR] Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.quentin.stdmod_18: [FR] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.quentin.stdmod_19: [FR] You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.quentin.stdmod_20: [FR] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.quentin.stdmod_21: [FR] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

npc.quentin.stdmod_23: [FR] I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.quentin.stdmod_24: [FR] I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.

npc.rafzan.stdmod_1: [FR] Are you here to get a task or to report you finished task?
npc.rafzan.stdmod_2: [FR] Me humble name is Rafzan. Good old goblin name meaning honest, generous and nice person, I swear!
npc.rafzan.stdmod_3: [FR] Most goblins so afraid of everything, that they fight everything. Me different. Me just want trade.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_4: [FR] You humans are so big, strong, clever and beautiful. Me really feel little and green beside you. Must be sooo fun to be human. You surely always make profit!
npc.rafzan.stdmod_5: [FR] To be honest to me human friend, me only heard about it, never seen one. I imagine it's something cute and cuddly.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_6: [FR] Swamp is horrible. Slowly eating away at health of poor little goblin. No profit here at all. Me will die poor and desperate, probably eaten by giant mosquitoes.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_7: [FR] Beardmen are nasty. Always want to kill little goblin. No trade at all. Not good, not good.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_8: [FR] So much to do, so little help. Me poor goblin desperately needs help. Me have a few tasks me need to be done. I can offer you all money I made if you only help me a little with stuff which is easy to strong smart human but impossible for poor, little me.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_9: [FR] Me heard Thais is big city with king! Must be strong and clever, to become chief of all humans. Me cannot imagine how many people you have to beat up to become king of all humans. Surely he makes lot of profit in his pretty city.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_10: [FR] They are mean and cruel. Humble goblin rarely trades with them. They would rather kill poor me if not too greedy for stuff only me can get them. Still, they rob me of it for a few spare coins and there is noooo profit for poor goblin.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_11: [FR] Me job merchant is. Me trade with all kinds of things. Me not good trader though, so you get everything incredibly cheap! You might think me mad, but please don't rip off poor goblin too much. Me has four or five wives and dozens of kids to feed!
npc.rafzan.stdmod_12: [FR] Humans so clever. Much, much smarter than poor, stupid goblin. They have big rich town. Goblin lives here poor and hungry. Me so impressed by you strong and smart humans. So much to learn from you. Poor goblin only sees pretty city from afar. Poor goblin too afraid to go there.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_13: [FR] Me have seen a gold coin once or twice. So bright and shiny it hurt me poor eyes. You surely are incredibly rich human who has even three or four coins at once! Perhaps you want to exchange them for some things me offer? Just don't rob me too much, me little stupid goblin, have no idea what stuff is worth... you look honest, you surely pay fair price like I ask and tell if it's too cheap.
npc.rafzan.stdmod_14: [FR] Furry guys are strange fellows. Always collecting things and stuff. Not easy to make them share, oh there is noooo profit for little, poor me to be made. They build underground dens that can stretch quite far. Rumour has it the corym have strange tunnels that connect their different networks all over the world.

npc.rapanaio.stdmod_1: [FR] Now that we have arrived you should waste no time and fight your way to the lair of evil and destroy its master before its too late!
npc.rapanaio.stdmod_2: [FR] Me humble name is Rapanaio. Good old goblin name meaning honest, generous and nice person, I swear!
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_1: [FR] I am a travelling trader. I don't buy everything, though. And not from everyone, for that matter.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_2: [FR] I am Rashid, son of the desert.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_3: [FR] Of course, old friend. You can also browse only armor, legs, shields, helmets, boots, weapons, enchanted weapons, jewelry or miscellaneous stuff.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_4: [FR] Elves... I don't really trust them. All this talk about nature and flowers and treehugging... I'm sure there's some wicked scheme behind all this.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_5: [FR] My beloved hometown! Ah, the sweet scent of the desert sands, the perfect shape of the pyramids... stunningly beautiful.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_6: [FR] I have to go to Carlin once in a while, since the queen wishes to see my exclusive wares in regular intervals.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_7: [FR] Cormaya? Not a good place to make business, it's way too far and small.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_8: [FR] It's not the real thing, but almost as good. The merchants there claim ridiculous prices, which is fine for my own business.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_9: [FR] Ah yes, Edron! Such a lovely and quiet island! I usually make some nice business there.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_10: [FR] Too few customers there, it's not worth the trip.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_12: [FR] I don't like being underground much. I also tend to get lost in these labyrinthine dwarven tunnels, so I rather avoid them.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_13: [FR] When you avoid the slums, it's a really pretty city. Almost as pretty as the governor's daughter.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_15: [FR] I like the settlement itself, but I don't set my foot into the jungle. Have you seen the size of these centipedes??
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_17: [FR] I wish it was a little bit warmer there, but with a good mug of barbarian mead in your tummy everything gets a lot cosier.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_18: [FR] I feel uncomfortable and rather unsafe in Thais, so I don't really travel there.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_20: [FR] Although it's the flourishing trade centre of Tibia, I don't like going there. Too much competition for my taste.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_21: [FR] It's almost time to journey on.
npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_22: [FR] Kings, queens, emperors and kaliphs... everyone claims to be different and unique, but actually it's the same thing everywhere.
